components.name: LLM Client
components.purpose: Requests typed tools and consumes results

components.name: Relay Server
components.purpose: Authenticates and routes device sessions without requiring inbound PC ports

components.name: PC Agent
components.purpose: Verifies signed requests and executes locally approved capabilities

components.name: Command Protocol
components.purpose: Defines signed expiring command envelopes and active-process replay checks

components.name: Policy Engine
components.purpose: Makes allow deny or approval decisions at the user device

data_flows.meaning: bounded execution result and audit metadata

external_boundaries.name: Public network
external_boundaries.contract: All remote device traffic is outbound from the agent and must be authenticated before execution.

external_boundaries.name: Local filesystem and process boundary
external_boundaries.contract: The PC agent policy engine is final authority for local access and execution.

external_boundaries.name: LLM provider API
external_boundaries.contract: Provider output is untrusted intent and cannot directly authorize privileged device operations.
